                elif key == 'user-agent': opts.user_agent = val
            else:
                sys.stderr.write(f"error: unexpected argument '--{key}' found\n\n  tip: to pass '--{key}' as a value, use '-- --{key}'\n\nUsage: executable [OPTIONS] <TARGET>\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
        elif arg.startswith('-') and len(arg) > 1:
            chars = arg[1:]
            c_idx = 0
            while c_idx < len(chars):
                c = chars[c_idx]
                if c in val_flags_short:
                    rest = chars[c_idx+1:]
                    if rest:
                        val = rest
                    else:
                        idx += 1
                        if idx >= n:
                            sys.stderr.write(f"error: a value is required for '-{c} <VALUE>' but none was supplied\n")
                            sys.exit(2)
                        val = argv[idx]
                    if c == 'b': opts.base_url = val
                    elif c == 'C': opts.cookie_file = val
                    elif c == 'd': opts.domains.append(val)
                    elif c == 'E': opts.encoding = val
                    elif c == 'o': opts.output = val
                    elif c == 't':
                        try: opts.timeout = float(val)
                        except: pass
                    elif c == 'u': opts.user_agent = val
                    break
                else:
                    if c == 'a': opts.no_audio = True
                    elif c == 'B': opts.blacklist_domains = True
                    elif c == 'c': opts.no_css = True
                    elif c == 'e': opts.ignore_errors = True
                    elif c == 'f': opts.no_frames = True
                    elif c == 'F': opts.no_fonts = True
                    elif c == 'i': opts.no_images = True
                    elif c == 'I': opts.isolate = True
                    elif c == 'j': opts.no_js = True
                    elif c == 'k': opts.insecure = True
                    elif c == 'm': opts.mhtml = True
                    elif c == 'M': opts.no_metadata = True
                    elif c == 'n': opts.unwrap_noscript = True
                    elif c == 'q': opts.quiet = True
                    elif c == 'v': opts.no_video = True
                    else:
                        sys.stderr.write(f"error: unexpected argument '-{c}' found\n\nUsage: executable [OPTIONS] <TARGET>\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                        sys.exit(2)
                c_idx += 1
        else:
            if opts.target is None:
                opts.target = arg
            else:
                sys.stderr.write(f"error: unexpected argument '{arg}' found\n\nUsage: executable [OPTIONS] <TARGET>\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
        idx += 1

    if opts.target is None:
        sys.stderr.write("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  <TARGET>\n\nUsage: executable <TARGET>\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
        sys.exit(2)

    return opts

def to_data_url(data_bytes, mime_type):
    if not mime_type:
        mime_type = ""
    b64 = base64.b64encode(data_bytes).decode('ascii')
    return f"data:{mime_type};base64,{b64}"

class Fetcher:
    def __init__(self, opts, base_url, is_stdin=False):
        self.opts = opts
        self.base_url = base_url
        self.is_stdin = is_stdin
        self.cache = {}
        self.cookie_header = None
        if opts.cookie_file and os.path.exists(opts.cookie_file):
            try:
                cj = http.cookiejar.MozillaCookieJar(opts.cookie_file)
                cj.load(ignore_discard=True, ignore_expires=True)
                cookies = [f"{c.name}={c.value}" for c in cj]
                if cookies:
                    self.cookie_header = "; ".join(cookies)
            except Exception:
                try:
                    with open(opts.cookie_file, 'r') as f:
                        lines = [line.strip() for line in f if line.strip() and not line.startswith('#')]
                        self.cookie_header = "; ".join(lines)
                except Exception:
                    pass

    def is_domain_allowed(self, url):
        if not self.opts.domains:
            return True
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(url)
        host = parsed.hostname or ""
        matched = False
        for d in self.opts.domains:
            d_clean = d.lstrip('.')
            if d.startswith('.'):
                if host == d_clean or host.endswith('.' + d_clean):
                    matched = True
                    break
            else:
                if host == d or host.endswith('.' + d):
                    matched = True
                    break
        if self.opts.blacklist_domains:
            return not matched
        else:
            return matched

    def fetch(self, url, cur_base_url=None):
        if not url:
            return None, None
        if cur_base_url:
            url = urllib.parse.urljoin(cur_base_url, url)

        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(url)

        if self.is_stdin and (not self.base_url or not urllib.parse.urlparse(self.base_url).scheme) and parsed.scheme == 'file':
            if not self.opts.quiet:
                sys.stderr.write(f"{url} (security error)\n")
            return None, None

        if not self.is_domain_allowed(url):
            return None, None

        if url in self.cache:
            if not self.opts.quiet:
                sys.stderr.write(f"{url} (from cache)\n")
            return self.cache[url]

        if not self.opts.quiet:
            sys.stderr.write(f"{url}")
            sys.stderr.flush()

        data = None
        mime = None
        err_msg = None

        if parsed.scheme == 'file' or not parsed.scheme:
            file_path = parsed.path if parsed.scheme == 'file' else url
            if os.path.exists(file_path):
                try:
                    with open(file_path, 'rb') as f:
                        data = f.read()
                    ext = file_path.rsplit('.', 1)[-1].lower() if '.' in file_path else ""
                    mime = MIME_TYPES_BY_EXT.get(ext, "")
                except Exception as e:
                    err_msg = str(e)
            else:
                err_msg = "file not found"
        elif parsed.scheme in ('http', 'https'):
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': self.opts.user_agent})
            if self.cookie_header:
                req.add_header('Cookie', self.cookie_header)
            ctx = ssl._create_unverified_context() if self.opts.insecure else ssl.create_default_context()
            try:
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=self.opts.timeout, context=ctx) as resp:
                    data = resp.read()
                    ct = resp.headers.get('Content-Type')
                    if ct:
                        mime = ct.split(';')[0].strip()
                    else:
                        ext = url.split('?')[0].rsplit('.', 1)[-1].lower() if '.' in url else ""
                        mime = MIME_TYPES_BY_EXT.get(ext, "")
            except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                err_msg = f"{e.code} {e.reason}"
            except Exception as e:
                err_msg = f"error sending request for url ({url})"
        else:
            err_msg = "unsupported scheme"

        if data is not None:
            if not self.opts.quiet:
                sys.stderr.write("\n")
                sys.stderr.flush()
            self.cache[url] = (data, mime)
            return (data, mime)
        else:
            if not self.opts.quiet:
                if self.opts.ignore_errors:
                    sys.stderr.write("\n")
                else:
                    sys.stderr.write(f" ({err_msg})\n")
                sys.stderr.flush()
            return None, None

class Node:
    def __init__(self, node_type, tag=None, attrs=None, text=None):
        self.node_type = node_type  # 'root', 'element', 'text', 'comment', 'doctype'
        self.tag = tag
        self.attrs = list(attrs) if attrs is not None else []
        self.text = text
        self.children = []
        self.parent = None
        self.raw_closing = False

    def add_child(self, child):
        child.parent = self
        self.children.append(child)

    def get_attr(self, name):
        for k, v in self.attrs:
            if k.lower() == name.lower():
                return v
        return None

    def set_attr(self, name, value):
        for idx, (k, v) in enumerate(self.attrs):
            if k.lower() == name.lower():
                self.attrs[idx] = (k, value)
                return
        self.attrs.append((name, value))

    def remove_attr(self, name):
        self.attrs = [(k, v) for k, v in self.attrs if k.lower() != name.lower()]

class HTMLTreeBuilder(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=False)
        self.root = Node('root')
        self.current = self.root

    def handle_decl(self, decl):
        node = Node('doctype', text=f"<!{decl}>")
        self.current.add_child(node)

    def handle_comment(self, data):
        node = Node('comment', text=data)
        self.current.add_child(node)

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        tag_lower = tag.lower()
        node = Node('element', tag=tag_lower, attrs=attrs)
        self.current.add_child(node)
        if tag_lower not in VOID_TAGS:
            self.current = node

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        tag_lower = tag.lower()
        curr = self.current
        while curr is not None and curr.node_type == 'element':
            if curr.tag == tag_lower:
                self.current = curr.parent
                break
            curr = curr.parent

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if data:
            node = Node('text', text=data)
            self.current.add_child(node)

def find_element(node, tag):
    if node.node_type == 'element' and node.tag == tag.lower():
        return node
    for child in node.children:
        res = find_element(child, tag)
        if res:
            return res
    return None

def normalize_tree(root):
    html_node = find_element(root, 'html')
    if not html_node:
        html_node = Node('element', tag='html')
        html_node.children = root.children
        for c in html_node.children:
            c.parent = html_node
        root.children = [html_node]
        html_node.parent = root

    head_node = find_element(html_node, 'head')
    if not head_node:
        head_node = Node('element', tag='head')
        html_node.children.insert(0, head_node)
        head_node.parent = html_node

    body_node = find_element(html_node, 'body')
    if not body_node:
        body_node = Node('element', tag='body')
        non_head = [c for c in html_node.children if c != head_node]
        html_node.children = [head_node, body_node]
        body_node.children = non_head
        for c in non_head:
            c.parent = body_node
        body_node.parent = html_node

def process_css_text(css_text, cur_base_url, fetcher, opts):
    if opts.no_fonts:
        css_text = re.sub(r'@font-face\s*\{[^}]*\}', '', css_text)

    def import_replacer(match):
        full = match.group(0)
        import_url = match.group(1) or match.group(2) or match.group(3)
        if not import_url:
            return full
        import_url = import_url.strip('\'"')
        if import_url.startswith('data:'):
            return full
        data, mime = fetcher.fetch(import_url, cur_base_url)
        if data is not None:
            mime = mime or "text/css"
            sub_css = data.decode(opts.encoding or 'utf-8', errors='replace')
            proc_sub = process_css_text(sub_css, urllib.parse.urljoin(cur_base_url, import_url), fetcher, opts)
            data_url = to_data_url(proc_sub.encode('utf-8'), mime)
            return f'@import "{data_url}";'
        return full

    css_text = re.sub(r'@import\s+(?:"([^"]+)"|\'([^\']+)\'|url\(([^)]+)\))\s*;?', import_replacer, css_text)

    def url_replacer(match):
        raw_url = match.group(1).strip('\'" \t\r\n')
        if raw_url.startswith('data:'):
            return f'url("{raw_url}")'

        hash_part = ""
        if '#' in raw_url:
            raw_url, hash_part = raw_url.split('#', 1)
            hash_part = '#' + hash_part

        if opts.no_images:
            return f'url("{TRANSPARENT_PNG_DATA_URL}{hash_part}")'

        data, mime = fetcher.fetch(raw_url, cur_base_url)
        if data is not None:
            data_url = to_data_url(data, mime)
            return f'url("{data_url}{hash_part}")'
        return f'url("{raw_url}{hash_part}")'

    css_text = re.sub(r'url\(([^)]+)\)', url_replacer, css_text)
    return css_text

def process_dom(node, cur_base_url, fetcher, opts):
    if node.node_type == 'element':
        tag = node.tag

        # Remove JS event handlers if -j
        if opts.no_js:
            event_attrs = [k for k, v in node.attrs if k.lower().startswith('on')]
            for k in event_attrs:
                node.remove_attr(k)

        # Style attribute
        style_val = node.get_attr('style')
        if style_val is not None:
            if opts.no_css:
                node.remove_attr('style')
            else:
                proc_style = process_css_text(style_val, cur_base_url, fetcher, opts)
                node.set_attr('style', proc_style)

        # Tag-specific logic
        if tag == 'img' or (tag == 'input' and node.get_attr('type') == 'image'):
            if opts.no_images:
                node.set_attr('src', TRANSPARENT_PNG_DATA_URL)
                srcset = node.get_attr('srcset')
                if srcset:
                    node.set_attr('srcset', TRANSPARENT_PNG_DATA_URL)
            else:
                src = node.get_attr('src')
                if src:
                    data, mime = fetcher.fetch(src, cur_base_url)
                    if data is not None:
                        node.set_attr('src', to_data_url(data, mime))

                srcset = node.get_attr('srcset')
                if srcset:
                    new_entries = []
                    for entry in srcset.split(','):
                        entry = entry.strip()
                        if not entry:
                            continue
                        parts = entry.split(None, 1)
                        u = parts[0]
                        desc = (" " + parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else ""
                        d, m = fetcher.fetch(u, cur_base_url)
                        if d is not None:
                            new_entries.append(to_data_url(d, m) + desc)
                        else:
                            new_entries.append(entry)
                    if new_entries:
                        node.set_attr('srcset', ", ".join(new_entries))
                        if node.get_attr('src') is None:
                            node.set_attr('src', "")

        elif tag == 'link':
            rel = node.get_attr('rel') or ""
            rel_lower = rel.lower()
            if 'stylesheet' in rel_lower:
                if opts.no_css:
                    node.remove_attr('href')
                else:
                    href = node.get_attr('href')
                    if href:
                        data, mime = fetcher.fetch(href, cur_base_url)
                        if data is not None:
                            css_str = data.decode(opts.encoding or 'utf-8', errors='replace')
                            proc_css = process_css_text(css_str, urllib.parse.urljoin(cur_base_url, href), fetcher, opts)
                            node.set_attr('href', to_data_url(proc_css.encode('utf-8'), mime or 'text/css'))
            elif any(x in rel_lower for x in ('icon', 'shortcut', 'apple-touch-icon', 'mask-icon')):
                href = node.get_attr('href')
                if href and not opts.no_images:
                    data, mime = fetcher.fetch(href, cur_base_url)
                    if data is not None:
                        node.set_attr('href', to_data_url(data, mime))
            elif rel_lower == 'preload' and node.get_attr('as') == 'font':
                if opts.no_fonts:
                    node.remove_attr('rel')

        elif tag == 'style':
            if opts.no_css:
                node.children = []
            else:
                full_text = "".join(c.text for c in node.children if c.node_type == 'text')
                if full_text:
                    proc_css = process_css_text(full_text, cur_base_url, fetcher, opts)
                    node.children = [Node('text', text=proc_css)]

        elif tag == 'script':
            if opts.no_js:
                node.remove_attr('src')
                node.children = []
            else:
                src = node.get_attr('src')
                if src:
                    data, mime = fetcher.fetch(src, cur_base_url)
                    if data is not None:
                        js_text = data.decode(opts.encoding or 'utf-8', errors='replace')
                        node.remove_attr('src')
                        node.children = [Node('text', text=js_text)]

        elif tag in ('audio', 'video', 'source'):
            is_audio = tag == 'audio' or (tag == 'source' and node.parent and node.parent.tag == 'audio')
            is_video = tag == 'video' or (tag == 'source' and node.parent and node.parent.tag == 'video')

            if (is_audio and opts.no_audio) or (is_video and opts.no_video):
                node.remove_attr('src')
            else:
                src = node.get_attr('src')
                if src:
                    data, mime = fetcher.fetch(src, cur_base_url)
                    if data is not None:
                        node.set_attr('src', to_data_url(data, mime))

        elif tag in ('iframe', 'frame'):
            if opts.no_frames:
                node.set_attr('src', "")
            else:
                src = node.get_attr('src')
                if src:
                    sub_url = urllib.parse.urljoin(cur_base_url, src)
                    data, mime = fetcher.fetch(src, cur_base_url)
                    if data is not None:
                        sub_html = data.decode(opts.encoding or 'utf-8', errors='replace')
                        proc_sub = process_document(sub_html, sub_url, fetcher, opts, is_subframe=True)
                        node.set_attr('src', to_data_url(proc_sub.encode('utf-8'), mime or 'text/html'))

        elif tag in ('image', 'use'):
            href = node.get_attr('href') or node.get_attr('xlink:href')
            if href:
                if '#' in href and tag == 'use':
                    pass
                else:
                    data, mime = fetcher.fetch(href, cur_base_url)
                    if data is not None:
                        if node.get_attr('href') is not None:
                            node.set_attr('href', to_data_url(data, mime))
                        if node.get_attr('xlink:href') is not None:
                            node.set_attr('xlink:href', to_data_url(data, mime))

        elif tag == 'noscript':
            if opts.unwrap_noscript:
                inner_text = "".join(serialize_node(c) for c in node.children)
                c_start = Node('comment', text='noscript')
                c_end = Node('comment', text='/noscript')
                txt_node = Node('text', text=inner_text)
                p = node.parent
                if p:
                    idx = p.children.index(node)
                    p.children[idx:idx+1] = [c_start, txt_node, c_end]
                    c_start.parent = p
                    c_end.parent = p
                    txt_node.parent = p
                return

    for child in list(node.children):
        process_dom(child, cur_base_url, fetcher, opts)

def process_head(root, opts, base_url, fetcher, is_html_target):
    html_node = find_element(root, 'html')
    if not html_node:
        return
    head_node = find_element(html_node, 'head')
    if not head_node:
        return

    # 1. CSP
    csp_parts = []
    if opts.isolate:
        csp_parts.append("default-src 'unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-inline' data:;")
    if opts.no_css:
        csp_parts.append("style-src 'none';")
    if opts.no_fonts:
        csp_parts.append("font-src 'none';")
    if opts.no_frames:
        csp_parts.append("frame-src 'none'; child-src 'none';")
    if opts.no_js or opts.mhtml:
        csp_parts.append("script-src 'none';")
    if opts.no_images:
        csp_parts.append("img-src data:;")

    if csp_parts:
        csp_content = " ".join(csp_parts)
        csp_meta = Node('element', tag='meta', attrs=[('http-equiv', 'Content-Security-Policy'), ('content', csp_content)])
        csp_meta.raw_closing = True
        head_node.children.insert(0, csp_meta)
        csp_meta.parent = head_node

    # 2. Base tag: ONLY if opts.base_url explicitly provided
    if opts.base_url:
        existing_base = find_element(head_node, 'base')
        if existing_base:
            existing_base.set_attr('href', opts.base_url)
        else:
            base_node = Node('element', tag='base', attrs=[('href', opts.base_url)])
            base_node.raw_closing = True
            head_node.children.append(base_node)
            base_node.parent = head_node

    # 3. Favicon check
    has_favicon = False
    for child in head_node.children:
        if child.node_type == 'element' and child.tag == 'link':
            rel = child.get_attr('rel') or ""
            if 'icon' in rel.lower():
                has_favicon = True
                break

    if not has_favicon and is_html_target and base_url and (base_url.startswith('http://') or base_url.startswith('https://')):
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(base_url)
        origin = f"{parsed.scheme}://{parsed.netloc}"
        fav_url = f"{origin}/favicon.ico"
        data, mime = fetcher.fetch(fav_url)
        if data:
            mime = mime or "image/vnd.microsoft.icon"
            data_url = to_data_url(data, mime)
            fav_node = Node('element', tag='link', attrs=[('rel', 'icon'), ('href', data_url)])
            fav_node.raw_closing = True
            head_node.children.append(fav_node)
            fav_node.parent = head_node

    # 4. Robots meta tag
    robots_meta = Node('element', tag='meta', attrs=[('name', 'robots'), ('content', 'none')])
    robots_meta.raw_closing = True
    head_node.children.append(robots_meta)
    robots_meta.parent = head_node

def serialize_node(node):
    if node.node_type == 'root':
        return "".join(serialize_node(c) for c in node.children)
    elif node.node_type == 'doctype':
        return node.text
    elif node.node_type == 'comment':
        return f"<!--{node.text}-->"
    elif node.node_type == 'text':
        return node.text
    elif node.node_type == 'element':
        attr_str = ""
        for name, val in node.attrs:
            if val is None:
                attr_str += f" {name}"
            else:
                val_escaped = str(val).replace('"', '"')
                attr_str += f' {name}="{val_escaped}"'
        if node.tag in VOID_TAGS and not node.raw_closing:
            return f"<{node.tag}{attr_str}>"
        else:
            inner = "".join(serialize_node(c) for c in node.children)
            return f"<{node.tag}{attr_str}>{inner}</{node.tag}>"

def process_document(html_content, base_url, fetcher, opts, is_subframe=False, is_html_target=True):
    parser = HTMLTreeBuilder()
    parser.feed(html_content)
    root = parser.root

    normalize_tree(root)
    process_dom(root, base_url, fetcher, opts)

    if not is_subframe:
        process_head(root, opts, base_url, fetcher, is_html_target)

    return serialize_node(root)

def main():
    opts = parse_args(sys.argv)

    target = opts.target
    is_stdin = (target == '-')

    if is_stdin:
        base_url = opts.base_url or ""
        target_display = ""
        is_http_target = False
        is_local_file = False
        try:
            raw_data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error reading STDIN: {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)
    else:
        if target.startswith('http://') or target.startswith('https://'):
            base_url = target
            target_display = target
            is_http_target = True
            is_local_file = False
        elif target.startswith('file://'):
            base_url = target
            target_display = target
            is_http_target = False
            is_local_file = True
        else:
            abs_path = os.path.abspath(target)
            base_url = f"file://{abs_path}"
            target_display = base_url
            is_http_target = False
            is_local_file = True

    fetcher = Fetcher(opts, base_url, is_stdin=is_stdin)

    if not is_stdin:
        data, mime = fetcher.fetch(target_display)
        if data is None:
            sys.stderr.write("Error: could not retrieve target document\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        raw_data = data
    else:
        mime = "text/html"

    enc = opts.encoding or "utf-8"
    try:
        html_str = raw_data.decode(enc, errors='replace')
    except Exception:
        html_str = raw_data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')

    now_utc = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

    output_html = process_document(html_str, base_url, fetcher, opts, is_subframe=False, is_html_target=True)

    header_comment = ""
    if not opts.no_metadata and not is_stdin:
        if is_local_file:
            header_comment = f"<!-- Saved from local source at {now_utc} using monolith v{VERSION} -->\n"
        else:

        for d in self.opts.domains:
            d_clean = d.lstrip('.')
            if d.startswith('.'):

class Node:
    def __init__(self, node_type, tag=None, attrs=None, text=None):
        self.node_type = node_type  # 'root', 'element', 'text', 'comment', 'doctype'
        self.tag = tag
        self.attrs = list(attrs) if attrs is not None else []
        self.text = text
        self.children = []
        self.parent = None
        self.raw_closing = False

    def add_child(self, child):
        child.parent = self
        self.children.append(child)

    def get_attr(self, name):
        for k, v in self.attrs:
            if k.lower() == name.lower():
                return v
        return None

    def set_attr(self, name, value):
        for idx, (k, v) in enumerate(self.attrs):
            if k.lower() == name.lower():
                self.attrs[idx] = (k, value)
                return
        self.attrs.append((name, value))

    def remove_attr(self, name):
        self.attrs = [(k, v) for k, v in self.attrs if k.lower() != name.lower()]

class HTMLTreeBuilder(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=False)
        self.root = Node('root')
        self.current = self.root

    def handle_decl(self, decl):
        node = Node('doctype', text=f"<!{decl}>")
        self.current.add_child(node)

    def handle_comment(self, data):
        node = Node('comment', text=data)
        self.current.add_child(node)

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        tag_lower = tag.lower()
        node = Node('element', tag=tag_lower, attrs=attrs)
        self.current.add_child(node)
        if tag_lower not in VOID_TAGS:
            self.current = node

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        tag_lower = tag.lower()
        curr = self.current
        while curr is not None and curr.node_type == 'element':
            if curr.tag == tag_lower:
                self.current = curr.parent
                break
            curr = curr.parent

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if data:
            node = Node('text', text=data)
            self.current.add_child(node)

def find_element(node, tag):
    if node.node_type == 'element' and node.tag == tag.lower():
        return node
    for child in node.children:
        res = find_element(child, tag)
        if res:
            return res
    return None

def normalize_tree(root):
    html_node = find_element(root, 'html')
    if not html_node:
        html_node = Node('element', tag='html')
        html_node.children = root.children
        for c in html_node.children:
            c.parent = html_node
        root.children = [html_node]
        html_node.parent = root

    head_node = find_element(html_node, 'head')
    if not head_node:
        head_node = Node('element', tag='head')
        html_node.children.insert(0, head_node)
        head_node.parent = html_node

    body_node = find_element(html_node, 'body')
    if not body_node:
        body_node = Node('element', tag='body')
        non_head = [c for c in html_node.children if c != head_node]
        html_node.children = [head_node, body_node]
        body_node.children = non_head
        for c in non_head:
            c.parent = body_node
        body_node.parent = html_node

def process_css_text(css_text, cur_base_url, fetcher, opts):
    if opts.no_fonts:
        css_text = re.sub(r'@font-face\s*\{[^}]*\}', '', css_text)

    def import_replacer(match):
        full = match.group(0)
        import_url = match.group(1) or match.group(2) or match.group(3)
        if not import_url:
            return full
        import_url = import_url.strip('\'"')
        if import_url.startswith('data:'):
            return full
        data, mime = fetcher.fetch(import_url, cur_base_url)
        if data is not None:
            mime = mime or "text/css"
            sub_css = data.decode(opts.encoding or 'utf-8', errors='replace')
            proc_sub = process_css_text(sub_css, urllib.parse.urljoin(cur_base_url, import_url), fetcher, opts)
            data_url = to_data_url(proc_sub.encode('utf-8'), mime)
            return f'@import "{data_url}";'
        return full

    css_text = re.sub(r'@import\s+(?:"([^"]+)"|\'([^\']+)\'|url\(([^)]+)\))\s*;?', import_replacer, css_text)

    def url_replacer(match):
        raw_url = match.group(1).strip('\'" \t\r\n')
        if raw_url.startswith('data:'):
            return f'url("{raw_url}")'

        hash_part = ""
        if '#' in raw_url:
            raw_url, hash_part = raw_url.split('#', 1)
            hash_part = '#' + hash_part

        if opts.no_images:
            return f'url("{TRANSPARENT_PNG_DATA_URL}{hash_part}")'

        data, mime = fetcher.fetch(raw_url, cur_base_url)
        if data is not None:
            data_url = to_data_url(data, mime)
            return f'url("{data_url}{hash_part}")'
        return f'url("{raw_url}{hash_part}")'

    css_text = re.sub(r'url\(([^)]+)\)', url_replacer, css_text)
    return css_text

def process_dom(node, cur_base_url, fetcher, opts):
    if node.node_type == 'element':
        tag = node.tag

        # Remove JS event handlers if -j

            event_attrs = [k for k, v in node.attrs if k.lower().startswith('on')]
            for k in event_attrs:
                node.remove_attr(k)

        style_val = node.get_attr('style')
        if style_val is not None:
            if opts.no_css:
                node.remove_attr('style')
            else:
                proc_style = process_css_text(style_val, cur_base_url, fetcher, opts)
                node.set_attr('style', proc_style)

        # Tag-specific logic
        if tag == 'img' or (tag == 'input' and node.get_attr('type') == 'image'):
            if opts.no_images:
                node.set_attr('src', TRANSPARENT_PNG_DATA_URL)
                srcset = node.get_attr('srcset')
                if srcset:
                    node.set_attr('srcset', TRANSPARENT_PNG_DATA_URL)
            else:
                src = node.get_attr('src')
                if src:
                    data, mime = fetcher.fetch(src, cur_base_url)
                    if data is not None:
                        node.set_attr('src', to_data_url(data, mime))

                srcset = node.get_attr('srcset')
                if srcset:
                    new_entries = []
                    for entry in srcset.split(','):
                        entry = entry.strip()
                        if not entry:
                            continue
                        parts = entry.split(None, 1)
                        u = parts[0]
                        desc = (" " + parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else ""
                        d, m = fetcher.fetch(u, cur_base_url)
                        if d is not None:
                            new_entries.append(to_data_url(d, m) + desc)
                        else:
                            new_entries.append(entry)
                    if new_entries:
                        node.set_attr('srcset', ", ".join(new_entries))
                        if node.get_attr('src') is None:
                            node.set_attr('src', "")

        elif tag == 'link':
            rel = node.get_attr('rel') or ""
            rel_lower = rel.lower()
            if 'stylesheet' in rel_lower:

                    node.remove_attr('href')
                else:
                    href = node.get_attr('href')
                    if href:
                        data, mime = fetcher.fetch(href, cur_base_url)
                        if data is not None:
                            css_str = data.decode(opts.encoding or 'utf-8', errors='replace')
                            proc_css = process_css_text(css_str, urllib.parse.urljoin(cur_base_url, href), fetcher, opts)
                            node.set_attr('href', to_data_url(proc_css.encode('utf-8'), mime or 'text/css'))
            elif any(x in rel_lower for x in ('icon', 'shortcut', 'apple-touch-icon', 'mask-icon')):
                href = node.get_attr('href')
                if href and not opts.no_images:
                    data, mime = fetcher.fetch(href, cur_base_url)

                        node.set_attr('href', to_data_url(data, mime))

                    node.remove_attr('rel')

            else:

    if opts.no_fonts:

    if opts.no_frames:
        csp_parts.append("frame-src 'none'; child-src 'none';")
    if opts.no_js or opts.mhtml:

    if opts.no_images:

            fav_node.parent = head_node

    robots_meta = Node('element', tag='meta', attrs=[('name', 'robots'), ('content', 'none')])
    robots_meta.raw_closing = True
    head_node.children.append(robots_meta)
    robots_meta.parent = head_node

def serialize_node(node):
    if node.node_type == 'root':
        return "".join(serialize_node(c) for c in node.children)
    elif node.node_type == 'doctype':
        return node.text
    elif node.node_type == 'comment':
        return f"<!--{node.text}-->"
    elif node.node_type == 'text':
        return node.text
    elif node.node_type == 'element':
        attr_str = ""
        for name, val in node.attrs:
            if val is None:
                attr_str += f" {name}"
            else:
                val_escaped = str(val).replace('"', '"')
                attr_str += f' {name}="{val_escaped}"'
        if node.tag in VOID_TAGS and not node.raw_closing:
            return f"<{node.tag}{attr_str}>"
        else:
            inner = "".join(serialize_node(c) for c in node.children)
            return f"<{node.tag}{attr_str}>{inner}</{node.tag}>"

def process_document(html_content, base_url, fetcher, opts, is_subframe=False, is_html_target=True):
    parser = HTMLTreeBuilder()
    parser.feed(html_content)
    root = parser.root

    normalize_tree(root)
    process_dom(root, base_url, fetcher, opts)

    if not is_subframe:
        process_head(root, opts, base_url, fetcher, is_html_target)

    return serialize_node(root)

        except Exception as e:

        node = Node('element', tag=tag_lower, attrs=attrs)
        self.current.add_child(node)
        if tag_lower not in VOID_TAGS:
            self.current = node

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        tag_lower = tag.lower()
        curr = self.current
        while curr is not None and curr.node_type == 'element':
            if curr.tag == tag_lower:
                self.current = curr.parent
                break
            curr = curr.parent

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if data:
            node = Node('text', text=data)
            self.current.add_child(node)

def find_element(node, tag):
    if node.node_type == 'element' and node.tag == tag.lower():
        return node
    for child in node.children:
        res = find_element(child, tag)
        if res:
            return res
    return None

def normalize_tree(root):
    html_node = find_element(root, 'html')
    if not html_node:
        html_node = Node('element', tag='html')
        html_node.children = root.children
        for c in html_node.children:
            c.parent = html_node
        root.children = [html_node]
        html_node.parent = root

    head_node = find_element(html_node, 'head')
    if not head_node:
        head_node = Node('element', tag='head')
        html_node.children.insert(0, head_node)
        head_node.parent = html_node

    body_node = find_element(html_node, 'body')
    if not body_node:
        body_node = Node('element', tag='body')
        non_head = [c for c in html_node.children if c != head_node]
        html_node.children = [head_node, body_node]
        body_node.children = non_head
        for c in non_head:
            c.parent = body_node
        body_node.parent = html_node

def process_css_text(css_text, cur_base_url, fetcher, opts):
    if opts.no_fonts:
        css_text = re.sub(r'@font-face\s*\{[^}]*\}', '', css_text)

    def import_replacer(match):
        full = match.group(0)
        import_url = match.group(1) or match.group(2) or match.group(3)
        if not import_url:
            return full
        import_url = import_url.strip('\'"')
        if import_url.startswith('data:'):
            return full
        data, mime = fetcher.fetch(import_url, cur_base_url)
        if data is not None:
            mime = mime or "text/css"
            sub_css = data.decode(opts.encoding or 'utf-8', errors='replace')
            proc_sub = process_css_text(sub_css, urllib.parse.urljoin(cur_base_url, import_url), fetcher, opts)
            data_url = to_data_url(proc_sub.encode('utf-8'), mime)
            return f'@import "{data_url}";'
        return full

    css_text = re.sub(r'@import\s+(?:"([^"]+)"|\'([^\']+)\'|url\(([^)]+)\))\s*;?', import_replacer, css_text)

    def url_replacer(match):
        raw_url = match.group(1).strip('\'" \t\r\n')
        if raw_url.startswith('data:'):
            return f'url("{raw_url}")'

        hash_part = ""
        if '#' in raw_url:
            raw_url, hash_part = raw_url.split('#', 1)
            hash_part = '#' + hash_part

        if opts.no_images:
            return f'url("{TRANSPARENT_PNG_DATA_URL}{hash_part}")'

        data, mime = fetcher.fetch(raw_url, cur_base_url)
        if data is not None:
            data_url = to_data_url(data, mime)
            return f'url("{data_url}{hash_part}")'
        return f'url("{raw_url}{hash_part}")'

    css_text = re.sub(r'url\(([^)]+)\)', url_replacer, css_text)
    return css_text

def process_dom(node, cur_base_url, fetcher, opts):
    if node.node_type == 'element':
        tag = node.tag

        # Remove JS event handlers if -j
        if opts.no_js:
            event_attrs = [k for k, v in node.attrs if k.lower().startswith('on')]
            for k in event_attrs:
                node.remove_attr(k)

        # Style attribute
        style_val = node.get_attr('style')
        if style_val is not None:
            if opts.no_css:
                node.remove_attr('style')
            else:
                proc_style = process_css_text(style_val, cur_base_url, fetcher, opts)
                node.set_attr('style', proc_style)

        # Tag-specific logic
        if tag == 'img' or (tag == 'input' and node.get_attr('type') == 'image'):
            if opts.no_images:
                node.set_attr('src', TRANSPARENT_PNG_DATA_URL)
                srcset = node.get_attr('srcset')
                if srcset:
                    node.set_attr('srcset', TRANSPARENT_PNG_DATA_URL)
            else:
                src = node.get_attr('src')
                if src:
                    data, mime = fetcher.fetch(src, cur_base_url)
                    if data is not None:
                        node.set_attr('src', to_data_url(data, mime))

                srcset = node.get_attr('srcset')
                if srcset:
                    new_entries = []
                    for entry in srcset.split(','):
                        entry = entry.strip()
                        if not entry:
                            continue
                        parts = entry.split(None, 1)
                        u = parts[0]
                        desc = (" " + parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else ""
                        d, m = fetcher.fetch(u, cur_base_url)
                        if d is not None:
                            new_entries.append(to_data_url(d, m) + desc)
                        else:
                            new_entries.append(entry)
                    if new_entries:
                        node.set_attr('srcset', ", ".join(new_entries))
                        if node.get_attr('src') is None:
                            node.set_attr('src', "")

        elif tag == 'link':
            rel = node.get_attr('rel') or ""
            rel_lower = rel.lower()
            if 'stylesheet' in rel_lower:
                if opts.no_css:
                    node.remove_attr('href')
                else:
                    href = node.get_attr('href')
                    if href:
                        data, mime = fetcher.fetch(href, cur_base_url)
                        if data is not None:
                            css_str = data.decode(opts.encoding or 'utf-8', errors='replace')
                            proc_css = process_css_text(css_str, urllib.parse.urljoin(cur_base_url, href), fetcher, opts)
                            node.set_attr('href', to_data_url(proc_css.encode('utf-8'), mime or 'text/css'))
            elif any(x in rel_lower for x in ('icon', 'shortcut', 'apple-touch-icon', 'mask-icon')):
                href = node.get_attr('href')
                if href and not opts.no_images:
                    data, mime = fetcher.fetch(href, cur_base_url)
                    if data is not None:
                        node.set_attr('href', to_data_url(data, mime))
            elif rel_lower == 'preload' and node.get_attr('as') == 'font':
                if opts.no_fonts:
                    node.remove_attr('rel')

        elif tag == 'style':
            if opts.no_css:
                node.children = []
            else:
                full_text = "".join(c.text for c in node.children if c.node_type == 'text')
                if full_text:
                    proc_css = process_css_text(full_text, cur_base_url, fetcher, opts)
                    node.children = [Node('text', text=proc_css)]

        elif tag == 'script':
            if opts.no_js:
                node.remove_attr('src')
                node.children = []
            else:
                src = node.get_attr('src')
                if src:
                    data, mime = fetcher.fetch(src, cur_base_url)
                    if data is not None:
                        js_text = data.decode(opts.encoding or 'utf-8', errors='replace')
                        node.remove_attr('src')
                        node.children = [Node('text', text=js_text)]

        elif tag in ('audio', 'video', 'source'):
            is_audio = tag == 'audio' or (tag == 'source' and node.parent and node.parent.tag == 'audio')
            is_video = tag == 'video' or (tag == 'source' and node.parent and node.parent.tag == 'video')

            if (is_audio and opts.no_audio) or (is_video and opts.no_video):
                node.remove_attr('src')
            else:
                src = node.get_attr('src')
                if src:
                    data, mime = fetcher.fetch(src, cur_base_url)
                    if data is not None:
                        node.set_attr('src', to_data_url(data, mime))

        elif tag in ('iframe', 'frame'):
            if opts.no_frames:
                node.set_attr('src', "")
            else:
                src = node.get_attr('src')
                if src:
                    sub_url = urllib.parse.urljoin(cur_base_url, src)
                    data, mime = fetcher.fetch(src, cur_base_url)
                    if data is not None:
                        sub_html = data.decode(opts.encoding or 'utf-8', errors='replace')
                        proc_sub = process_document(sub_html, sub_url, fetcher, opts, is_subframe=True)
                        node.set_attr('src', to_data_url(proc_sub.encode('utf-8'), mime or 'text/html'))

        elif tag in ('image', 'use'):
            href = node.get_attr('href') or node.get_attr('xlink:href')
            if href:
                if '#' in href and tag == 'use':
                    pass
                else:
                    data, mime = fetcher.fetch(href, cur_base_url)
                    if data is not None:
                        if node.get_attr('href') is not None:
                            node.set_attr('href', to_data_url(data, mime))
                        if node.get_attr('xlink:href') is not None:
                            node.set_attr('xlink:href', to_data_url(data, mime))

        elif tag == 'noscript':
            if opts.unwrap_noscript:
                inner_text = "".join(serialize_node(c) for c in node.children)
                c_start = Node('comment', text='noscript')
                c_end = Node('comment', text='/noscript')
                txt_node = Node('text', text=inner_text)
                p = node.parent
                if p:
                    idx = p.children.index(node)
                    p.children[idx:idx+1] = [c_start, txt_node, c_end]
                    c_start.parent = p
                    c_end.parent = p
                    txt_node.parent = p
                return

    for child in list(node.children):
        process_dom(child, cur_base_url, fetcher, opts)

def process_head(root, opts, base_url, fetcher, is_html_target):
    html_node = find_element(root, 'html')
    if not html_node:
        return
    head_node = find_element(html_node, 'head')
    if not head_node:
        return

    # 1. CSP
    csp_parts = []
    if opts.isolate:
        csp_parts.append("default-src 'unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-inline' data:;")
    if opts.no_css:
        csp_parts.append("style-src 'none';")
    if opts.no_fonts:
        csp_parts.append("font-src 'none';")
    if opts.no_frames:
        csp_parts.append("frame-src 'none'; child-src 'none';")
    if opts.no_js or opts.mhtml:
        csp_parts.append("script-src 'none';")
    if opts.no_images:
        csp_parts.append("img-src data:;")

    if csp_parts:
        csp_content = " ".join(csp_parts)
        csp_meta = Node('element', tag='meta', attrs=[('http-equiv', 'Content-Security-Policy'), ('content', csp_content)])
        csp_meta.raw_closing = True
        head_node.children.insert(0, csp_meta)
        csp_meta.parent = head_node

    # 2. Base tag: ONLY if opts.base_url explicitly provided
    if opts.base_url:
        existing_base = find_element(head_node, 'base')
        if existing_base:
            existing_base.set_attr('href', opts.base_url)
        else:
            base_node = Node('element', tag='base', attrs=[('href', opts.base_url)])
            base_node.raw_closing = True
            head_node.children.append(base_node)
            base_node.parent = head_node

    # 3. Favicon check
    has_favicon = False
    for child in head_node.children:
        if child.node_type == 'element' and child.tag == 'link':
            rel = child.get_attr('rel') or ""
            if 'icon' in rel.lower():
                has_favicon = True
                break

    if not has_favicon and is_html_target and base_url and (base_url.startswith('http://') or base_url.startswith('https://')):
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(base_url)
        origin = f"{parsed.scheme}://{parsed.netloc}"
        fav_url = f"{origin}/favicon.ico"
        data, mime = fetcher.fetch(fav_url)
        if data:
            mime = mime or "image/vnd.microsoft.icon"
            data_url = to_data_url(data, mime)
            fav_node = Node('element', tag='link', attrs=[('rel', 'icon'), ('href', data_url)])
            fav_node.raw_closing = True
            head_node.children.append(fav_node)
            fav_node.parent = head_node

    # 4. Robots meta tag
    robots_meta = Node('element', tag='meta', attrs=[('name', 'robots'), ('content', 'none')])
    robots_meta.raw_closing = True
    head_node.children.append(robots_meta)
    robots_meta.parent = head_node

def serialize_node(node):
    if node.node_type == 'root':
        return "".join(serialize_node(c) for c in node.children)
    elif node.node_type == 'doctype':
        return node.text
    elif node.node_type == 'comment':
        return f"<!--{node.text}-->"
    elif node.node_type == 'text':
        return node.text
    elif node.node_type == 'element':
        attr_str = ""
        for name, val in node.attrs:
            if val is None:
                attr_str += f" {name}"
            else:
                val_escaped = str(val).replace('"', '"')
                attr_str += f' {name}="{val_escaped}"'
        if node.tag in VOID_TAGS and not node.raw_closing:
            return f"<{node.tag}{attr_str}>"
        else:
            inner = "".join(serialize_node(c) for c in node.children)
            return f"<{node.tag}{attr_str}>{inner}</{node.tag}>"

def process_document(html_content, base_url, fetcher, opts, is_subframe=False, is_html_target=True):
    parser = HTMLTreeBuilder()
    parser.feed(html_content)
    root = parser.root

    normalize_tree(root)
    process_dom(root, base_url, fetcher, opts)

    if not is_subframe:
        process_head(root, opts, base_url, fetcher, is_html_target)

    return serialize_node(root)

def main():
    opts = parse_args(sys.argv)

    target = opts.target
    is_stdin = (target == '-')

    if is_stdin:
        base_url = opts.base_url or ""
        target_display = ""
        is_http_target = False
        is_local_file = False
        try:
            raw_data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error reading STDIN: {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)
    else:
        if target.startswith('http://') or target.startswith('https://'):
            base_url = target
            target_display = target
            is_http_target = True
            is_local_file = False
        elif target.startswith('file://'):
            base_url = target
            target_display = target
            is_http_target = False
            is_local_file = True
        else:
            abs_path = os.path.abspath(target)
            base_url = f"file://{abs_path}"
            target_display = base_url
            is_http_target = False
            is_local_file = True

    fetcher = Fetcher(opts, base_url, is_stdin=is_stdin)

    if not is_stdin:
        data, mime = fetcher.fetch(target_display)
        if data is None:
            sys.stderr.write("Error: could not retrieve target document\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        raw_data = data
    else:
        mime = "text/html"

    enc = opts.encoding or "utf-8"
    try:
        html_str = raw_data.decode(enc, errors='replace')
    except Exception:
        html_str = raw_data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')

    now_utc = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

    output_html = process_document(html_str, base_url, fetcher, opts, is_subframe=False, is_html_target=True)

    header_comment = ""
    if not opts.no_metadata and not is_stdin:
        if is_local_file:
            header_comment = f"<!-- Saved from local source at {now_utc} using monolith v{VERSION} -->\n"
        else:
            header_comment = f"<!-- Saved from {target_display} at {now_utc} using monolith v{VERSION} -->\n"

    final_content = header_comment + output_html + "\n"

    if opts.mhtml:
        location = target_display if target_display else "http://example.com/"
        mhtml_buf = []
        mhtml_buf.append("MIME-Version: 1.0\n")
        mhtml_buf.append('Content-Type: multipart/related; boundary="----=_NextPart_000_0000"\n\n')
        mhtml_buf.append("------=_NextPart_000_0000\n")
        mhtml_buf.append('Content-Type: text/html; charset="utf-8"\n')
        mhtml_buf.append(f"Content-Location: {location}\n\n")
        mhtml_buf.append(final_content)
        mhtml_buf.append("------=_NextPart_000_0000--\n")
        final_content = "".join(mhtml_buf)

    if opts.output and opts.output != '-':
        try:
            with open(opts.output, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                f.write(final_content)
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"could not prepare output: {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(final_content)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
